categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Silicon Industry Group Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor silicon wafers. Its product portfolio includes 300mm polished and epitaxial wafers, 200mm and smaller polished and epitaxial wafers, SOI wafers, and piezoelectric thin film substrate materials. These products serve various semiconductor applications such as memory chips, image sensors, general processors, power devices, sensors, RF chips, analog chips, and discrete devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered multiple core technologies including Czochralski and magnetic field Czochralski single crystal growth, thermal field simulation and design, large-diameter silicon ingot slicing, high-precision rounding, low-stress wire cutting, chemical etching, double-sided grinding, edge grinding, double-sided and single-sided polishing, wafer cleaning, epitaxy, and SOI wafer preparation technologies. It has overcome key technical bottlenecks in near-perfect 300mm single crystal growth, ultra-flat polishing, and extreme characterization, establishing an internationally advanced 300mm silicon material characterization system.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major global and domestic semiconductor manufacturers including TSMC, UMC, GlobalFoundries, STMicroelectronics, TowerJazz, SMIC, Hua Hong Semiconductor, Huahong Microelectronics, and China Resources Microelectronics. Its customers span North America, Europe, China, and other Asian countries. The end markets include memory, logic, image sensors, automotive electronics, industrial electronics, 5G communications, and emerging fields such as AI and IoT.
categories.geographic_coverage: Shanghai Silicon Industry Group operates primarily in China with significant production facilities in Shanghai and expanding capacity in Taiyuan. It also has subsidiaries in Finland (Okmetic) and sales and support teams in Europe, North America, Japan, and Hong Kong, reflecting a global operational footprint. The company’s financial reports are consolidated in RMB, with subsidiaries using local currencies such as the Euro.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as a key supplier of semiconductor-grade silicon wafers, which are essential raw materials for downstream semiconductor chip manufacturing. It focuses on wafer production and related materials, supporting chip fabrication processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on advancing 300mm wafer technology, high-end silicon base materials, SOI wafers, epitaxial wafers, and piezoelectric thin film substrates. It pursues a 'one-stop' silicon materials service strategy, expanding production capacity, enriching product structure, and enhancing market share. Collaboration with academic and research institutions and participation in national major projects underpin its innovation efforts.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor silicon wafers and related materials to chip manufacturers. The company employs a direct sales model, supplemented by limited use of agents for smaller customers. It also earns income from entrusted processing services and strategic equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global semiconductor silicon wafer industry is oligopolistic, dominated by five major players: Shin-Etsu Chemical, SUMCO, GlobalWafers, Siltronic, and SK Siltron, collectively holding about 90% market share. Shanghai Silicon Industry Group positions itself as a leading domestic player aiming to close the technology and market gap with these global leaders, expanding capacity and product breadth to enhance competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported total assets of approximately RMB 29.03 billion, a 14% increase from the previous year, and net assets attributable to shareholders of RMB 15.11 billion, up 5.76%. Revenue was RMB 3.19 billion, down 11.39% year-over-year due to market downturns, with net profit attributable to shareholders at RMB 186.54 million, a 42.61% decrease. The company continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, maintaining a growth trajectory despite cyclical industry challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Silicon Industry Group offers a comprehensive product portfolio covering multiple wafer sizes and types, including advanced 300mm wafers and specialized SOI and piezoelectric materials. It emphasizes high-quality, domestically produced silicon wafers with international-level technology and certifications, aiming to reduce reliance on imports and meet diverse customer needs. Its integrated R&D capabilities, global customer base, and strategic partnerships provide differentiated value in technology innovation, product customization, and supply chain security.
